text:
Alex: Quick poll — the pigeon that photobombs our 3pm standups needs an official name. Reply with ONE word (keep it silly). If you secretly want to be on a tiny naming committee, drop a :hand:. I'll pick the top 3 tomorrow morning.
Priya: Percy
Jamal: Pebble
Casey: WindowSeat
Morgan: Binx
Dana: Squawk :bird:
Taylor: @Alex I nominate Statler (very grumpy energy) :grin:
Alex: Statler is hilarious. Also small bribe policy: bring a tiny banana tomorrow and I'll reimburse :banana:
Priya: I will bring one. +1 for Binx
Jamal: Can we make a tiny name plaque for the ledge? :plaque:
Casey: I can craft a plaque during lunch.
Lunch-bot: Today's special: teriyaki tofu bowl — highly recommend.
Morgan: Tally so far: Percy(1), Pebble(1), WindowSeat(1), Binx(2), Squawk(1), Statler(1)
Dana: Moving my vote to Binx -> Binx now 3
Alex: OKAY. BINX is the temporary champion. Rollout plan: small post-it on the ledge at 10am, optional tiny sticker distribution after 11.
Taylor: Sticker pls. Also shoutout to @Dana for the decisive swing. :tada:
Casey: +1 for stickers, and I volunteer to make one tiny laminated plaque.
Alex: Amazing. Closing thread for sticker logistics — if you want a sticker DM me. Thanks for the quick chaos, team :heart:
